scientific_conclusion_so_far: Preserving theta/C derivative consistency is necessary for nonlinear robustness but not sufficient for universal nonlinear-path invariance. In boundary-sensitive prescribed-flux regimes, trajectory-local retention/capacity representation error can add nonlinear work even when endpoint hydraulic error is tiny, and that extra work can reverse the speed benefit.
